observations_and_findings.mechanism: The raw public and deserializable Millimeters(u16) wall thickness reaches validate_breastplate, which validates the profile and then the Anime relation before its own 1–20 gauge gate. An otherwise-valid default profile and Anime scalar controls reach lap_lift.0 < gauge.0 * 2. Gauge 32768 or u16::MAX overflows the u16 product when overflow checks are enabled, before structured parent rejection.
observations_and_findings.wrapping_qualification: With overflow checks disabled, 32768 doubles to 0 and default lap lift 7 passes this relation before the outer invalid-gauge rejection. By contrast u16::MAX doubles to 65534 and default lift 7 fails the Anime relation, returning BreastplateShape before the outer gate. The 774 native-021 historical assertion that MAX wraps and is later rejected is preserved verbatim, but its location of rejection is refined by this source/arithmetic reasoning; no build-profile behavior was executed.

thirteen_lenses.producer-propagation: Raw Serde/public design fields flow to explicit bracer codec/validation and breastplate validation/hash; public fluting helper exposes separate input contract. Full producer-to-native caller coverage remains open.
thirteen_lenses.existing-type-owners: Millimeters, Micrometers, Permille and FluteCount already express units/count; raw backings do not by themselves seal an admitted range. No universal interval for Permille.
thirteen_lenses.admission-contracts: Public DTO/Serde permit values before aggregate validation. Gauge relation is evaluated before parent bound; fluting optional validation is explicit at inspected bracer/breastplate gates, not proven for every helper caller.
thirteen_lenses.invariant-operations: Raw u16 gauge doubling can overflow before the bound. Fluting subtraction/fade doubling are short-circuit bounded; zero base divisions are conditional public helper behavior.
thirteen_lenses.aggregate-states: Anime gauge/lap lift, fluting end/start/fade and bracer coverage/offset are relationships beyond individual word types. Existing checks establish only their scoped gates.
thirteen_lenses.type-ownership: Parent breastplate admission and Anime relation share the gauge contract; choose an admitted gauge or aggregate owner without assuming a universal Millimeters bound. Pattern/segment owner remains open.
thirteen_lenses.redundant-authority: The read bodies show validators and raw data but no independently retained conflicting gauge or duplicate truth by themselves; future tracing of mutable producer/caches remains open.
thirteen_lenses.behavior-preservation: Preserve admitted gauge/lap relations, valid zero dimensions, >1000 scale factors, optional fluting, intended errors and bracer endpoint policy. No promise to preserve invalid overflow or legacy interfaces.
thirteen_lenses.enum-shapes: BreastplateConstruction directly owns its Anime payload; optional fluting is a distinct represented state. Variant construction alone does not validate aggregate combinations.
thirteen_lenses.derivability: Standard Clone/Eq/Hash/Serde derives are visible; serde deny_unknown_fields and validation are separate. No need or basis to weaken admission by changing derives here.
thirteen_lenses.type-granularity: Count, fraction-like scales and lengths have different semantic ranges even when u16 backed. Distinct factor versus probability use and raw versus admitted values should remain explicit.
thirteen_lenses.magic-strings: Bracer catalog_id String/default vambrace and nonblank check expose an identity boundary, not proof of a closed vocabulary or a new defect. Resolve actual producer/consumer ownership and existing catalog record.
thirteen_lenses.magic-numbers: Fluting bounds, 8 profile samples, 32 bracer base segments, 1e-5 merge tolerance and factor 2 describe scoped operations. Their ownership/topology policy needs consumers; no blanket replacement or correctness inference.
